Map a raw metric value to a 0-100 quality sub-score

Source: R/quality-score.R
score_curve.Rd

Piecewise-linear scoring curve anchored on a green (full marks, 100) and amber (half marks, 50) threshold, extrapolated linearly to a hard 0 floor an equal step beyond amber, and clamped to [0, 100]. Returns NA when the value or either threshold is NA, so undefined dimensions drop out of the composite rather than scoring as 0.

Usage

score_curve(x, green, amber, direction = c("higher_better", "lower_better"))

Arguments

x

Numeric raw metric value (may be NA).

green

Threshold scoring 100.

amber

Threshold scoring 50.

direction

"higher_better" (larger is better) or "lower_better".

Value

A numeric sub-score in [0, 100], or NA_real_.

Examples

score_curve(0.82, green = 0.80, amber = 0.60, direction = "higher_better")
#> [1] 100
score_curve(0.40, green = 5,    amber = 10,   direction = "lower_better")
#> [1] 100
